/-- Returns the underlying `n`-monadic representation of a `ULiftT n α` value. -/
@[always_inline, inline]
def ULiftT.run {n : Type max u v → Type v'} {α : Type u} (x : ULiftT n α) : n (ULift.{v} α) :=
  x
